title: Folic acid supplementation to prevent neural tube defects in persons who plan to or could become pregnant

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that all persons planning to or who could become pregnant take a daily supplement containing 0.4 to 0.8 mg (400 to 800 mcg) of folic acid.

action: Recommend a daily supplement containing 0.4 to 0.8 mg (400 to 800 mcg) of folic acid
